[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
Margaret McEachin, also indexed as McCachen and McGechan, was born on 16 March 1711 and baptised on 25 March at Kilmarnock, Ayrshire. The derivative baptism index names her father as Duncan McCachen and her mother as Marion Harper.<ref name="margaretbirth">FamilySearch, ''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950'', [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XYQZ-4NB Margaret McCachen, 1711]. The original page has not been compared with the index.</ref>

A Kilmarnock marriage index records Hugh Glasgow and Margaret McEachin on 20 March 1732.<ref name="marriage">FamilySearch, ''Scotland, Marriages, 1561–1910'', {{FamilySearch Record|XT24-XWR}}, Hugh Glasgow and Margaret McEachin, 20 March 1732. Check the original for the spelling and any residence or kin details.</ref> Kilmarnock baptism indexes name Hugh and mothers transcribed as Margaret McEachan for [[Glasgow-4142|Mary]] (17 December 1732), Margaret McGlashan for [[Glasgow-4115|Margaret]] (31 August 1738), and Margaret McGechan for [[Glasgow-4104|Hugh]] (29 August 1742).<ref name="children">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', Kilmarnock Old Parish Register, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3599128&tab=this Mary Glasgow, 17 December 1732]. The individual child profiles cite their indexed entries.</ref>

Other children currently attached to Margaret and Hugh include [[Glasgow-3469|Jean]] (1735), [[Glasgow-3468|Ann]] (1749), [[Glasgow-3470|Hugh]] (1752), and [[Glasgow-3298|John]] (1755). John's Glasgow baptism index names the mother as Margtt. McKechny.<ref name="john1755">FamilySearch, ''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950'', [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VRS2-MNP John Glasgo, 19/23 April 1755].</ref> Compare each original entry before treating all attached children as one documented sequence.

== Research Notes ==
=== Kilmarnock glover household ===

The Kilmarnock baptism transcripts for Mary in 1732, Margaret in 1738 and Hugh in 1742 each name their father as Hugh Glasgow, a glover, resident at Kilmk (Kilmarnock). Repeated name, specific trade, locality and compatible child sequence identify one paternal household much more strongly than surname and chronology alone. The adult glover is represented by [[Glasgow-1929|Hugh Glasgow]]. Each of these three father–child roles is assessed separately at 99% subjective confidence. This concerns the recorded glover as father; his further identification with the 1710 Kilwinning child is an independent inferred step, not newly proved by these baptisms.

The retained transcripts actually give three maternal surname readings: McEachan for Mary in 1732, McGlashan for Margaret in 1738, and McGechan for Hugh in 1742. The 1732 marriage names Margaret McEachin. The same father, glover trade, parish and repeated Margaret given name support one family, but the McGlashan reading deserves separate treatment. The identification with [[McEachin-120|Margaret McEachin]] is assessed at 98% for Mary, 98% for Hugh and 84% for Margaret. McEachan and McGechan are compatible renderings in this specific household. McGlashan could be a transcription error or could distinguish another mother; the original entry is needed to resolve it.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3599128&tab=this Findmypast retained transcript SCOT/OPR/BAP/3599128: Mary, 1732-12-17, OPR 597/1 item1 p.150; father Hugh Glasgow, glover; mother Margaret McEachan]. [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3599918&tab=this Findmypast retained transcript SCOT/OPR/BAP/3599918: Margaret, 1738-08-31, OPR 597/1 item1 p.206; father Hugh Glasgow, glover; mother Margaret McGlashan]. [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3600403&tab=this Findmypast retained transcript SCOT/OPR/BAP/3600403: Hugh, 1742-08-29, OPR 597/2 item2 p.20; father Hugh Glasgow, glover; mother Margaret McGechan]. [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XT24-XWR FamilySearch XT24-XWR: Hugh Glasgow and Margaret McEachin, 20 March 1732, Kilmarnock; existing cited index, original uninspected].</ref>

The original register images have not been inspected. The 1744 Mary baptism naming Margaret Giffen remains a separate unresolved maternal comparison. These parental-role assessments do not establish the glover’s identification with the 1710 Kilwinning child.

[[McGechan-24]] was merged into this profile on 27 September 2026. The same given name, compatible surname forms, March 1732 Hugh Glasgow marriage and December 1732 child in Kilmarnock make one Margaret the best identification. The former McGechan birth estimate before 1713 was based only on adult parenthood; the 1711 index supplies a more specific candidate. The old profile's three Kilmarnock child citations are retained.

One 1744 Kilmarnock child attributed to a Hugh Glasgow names a different mother, Margaret Giffen. That entry remains a separate unresolved maternal identification; it does not change the wording of Margaret McEachin's recorded child entries or establish a death or remarriage. The two Hugh father profiles also require a qualified duplicate assessment.

An earlier profile biography linked Margaret's McEachin family to Scottish clan chiefs. The Kilmarnock baptism and marriage do not demonstrate that descent; it is retained here only as an unproved family-history suggestion.
